single_submit_state_machine.claim: an atomic idle-to-submit_claimed transition occurs immediately before the sole native submit callback
single_submit_state_machine.repeat: every later execute call on the same state is rejected without invoking submit again
single_submit_state_machine.ack: a successful queue handoff returns submitted_receipt_pending; it never claims that CK3 applied or accepted the proposal
single_submit_state_machine.native_reject: a rejected or unavailable submit callback is terminal and remains rejected_before_submit

receipt_contract.freshness: a later paused observation must advance public revision, native revision and proof epoch without moving date backwards
receipt_contract.identity: the full subject and candidate IDs, identity round trips and liveness are rechecked
receipt_contract.relationship: both parties must independently report the same spouse or betrothal edge; one-sided or simultaneous marriage/betrothal evidence is an observation failure
receipt_contract.alliance: both parties must independently report the same alliance edge; the receipt records both a present and an absent alliance as an observed result
receipt_contract.pending: no relationship plus native pending remains verification_pending and leaves the action state open for a later receipt
receipt_contract.success: a symmetric spouse or betrothal edge matching the pinned predicted outcome closes as succeeded_marriage or succeeded_betrothal
receipt_contract.refusal: an explicit native refused resolution with no resulting relationship closes as refused
receipt_contract.invalidation: an explicit invalidated resolution, identity/liveness loss, an outcome-kind change, or accepted-without-relationship closes as invalidated
